headline: Global Education wins Rs 3.485 crore laptop order
summary: Global Education secured a Rs 3.485 crore order from Iris Global Services for 850 Acer laptops. This follows a Rs 1.61 crore digital display order from 3C IT Solutions in August.

headline: Aequs to issue warrants to promoter
summary: Aequs Ltd schedules board meeting on September 25, 2026, to consider preferential issue of warrants convertible into equity shares to the promoter.

headline: Hec Infra Projects wins Rs 7.45 crore order from M/S Nakshatra Infra
summary: Hec Infra Projects secured a Rs 7.45 crore order from M/S Nakshatra Infra for electrical and HVAC works at a Vadodara museum. The contract has a 6-month execution period.

headline: Rappid Valves wins Rs 85.31 lakh order from Hindustan Shipyard
summary: Rappid Valves secures Rs 85.31 lakh order from Hindustan Shipyard for Fleet Support Ship valves. Execution by Mar 2027. Recent inflow stable at ~Rs 30 crore per quarter.

headline: Presstonic wins Rs 2.63 crore order from Titagarh for Surat Metro
summary: Presstonic Engineering secures a confirmed work order worth Rs 2.63 crore from Titagarh Rail Systems for cable duct assemblies for the Surat Metro project. The order adds to the company's recent inflow, though quarterly revenue remains at zero.

headline: Value 360 wins Rs 4.74 crore Amazon PR retainer
summary: Value 360 Communications secures a Rs 4.74 crore services agreement with Amazon Development Centre for public relations. The order spans one year. No prior order disclosures exist in the last three quarters, making this the first visible data point.

headline: DEE Development Engineers to host plant visit
summary: DEE Development Engineers Limited has scheduled an investor and analyst plant visit at its Anjar facility in Gujarat on September 30, 2026, as per SEBI regulations.

headline: Oriana Power wins Rs 3870 crore BESS order from MSEDCL
summary: Oriana Power secures Rs 3870 crore for 900 MW/1800 MWh Battery Energy Storage Systems in Maharashtra. This mega order significantly boosts the company's order book against a backdrop of recent smaller EPC wins.

headline: Abhishek Integrations wins Rs 0.41 crore order from AAI for Surat Airport
summary: Abhishek Integrations secured a Rs 0.41 crore contract from the Airports Authority of India for supplying GLF spares at Surat International Airport. The 12-month deal adds to recent wins in Q2FY27.

headline: US imposes visa curbs on 32 Prince Group TCO-linked individuals
summary: The US State Department has imposed visa restrictions on 32 individuals linked to the Prince Group transnational criminal organisation, signalling a firm enforcement stance.

headline: Stocks in Focus: GK Energy, GRSE, Waaree Energies
summary: GK Energy surges 5.7% on 150 MW storage win. GRSE approves ₹2,896 cr capex for Raichak shipyard. Waaree secures 2 GW solar order. Symbiotec profit dips.

headline: Embassy signs ₹711 Cr MoU for Juhu tower sale
summary: Embassy Developments signs MoU to sell entire residential tower at Embassy Terazza to Dinesh Thakkar for ₹711 crore. The 63,000 sq ft unit marks India's largest single residential transaction.

headline: Sterling & Wilson wins contracts worth ~₹985 crore
summary: Sterling & Wilson Renewable Energy has secured major domestic and international contracts worth approximately ₹985 crore, strengthening its order pipeline.

headline: Sterling & Wilson Renewable Energy wins Rs 985 crore order from IPP and Middle East developer
summary: Company secures Rs 985 crore work order for Rajasthan BOS and South Africa BESS projects. Total disclosed backlog stands at Rs 4670 crore. Recent quarterly revenue shows margin recovery despite high leverage.

headline: ONGC strikes deepwater gas find off Odisha coast
summary: ONGC has made a deepwater gas discovery off the Odisha coast, with the state-run explorer eyeing early monetisation as part of a ₹1 lakh crore offshore exploration push.

headline: Edible oil prices set for third hike since March
summary: Edible oil prices in India may rise 7-8% as a weaker rupee and higher import costs push companies including AWL Agri and Marico toward a third price hike since March.

headline: Bandhan Financial may sell bank stake in tranches by 2030
summary: Bandhan Financial Services may divest its stake in Bandhan Bank in tranches to comply with the 26% promoter holding limit by 2030, as reported by a newspaper.

headline: Govt may tighten medical device safety rules
summary: The government may tighten medical device regulations, granting licensing authorities the power to halt manufacture and sale of unsafe products, according to a newspaper report.

headline: JSW Cement: earnings outlook tied to input costs
summary: JSW Cement's near-term earnings outlook depends on input-cost trends, margin management, and cost control, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Carlyle plans up to $400 million IPO for Highway Roop
summary: Carlyle is preparing an IPO of auto-parts platform Highway Roop Precision Technologies in India, targeting up to $400 million, according to a newspaper report.

headline: MasterCard to sell 4.3% Pine Labs stake at discount
summary: MasterCard plans to offload a 4.3% stake in Pine Labs via a large trade at ₹179.50, representing a 7.3% discount to the NSE close. The transaction involves roughly 48.5 million shares.

headline: Rupee opens stronger at 95.7475 against dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 95.7475 against the US dollar, firmer than its previous close of 95.8150, reflecting a marginal gain in early trade.
